paraphrase: Viṣṇu alone is to be inquired into: the maker of all, made known by scripture, (shown) by the concordance of the texts and by his 'seeing' (before creation), full of bliss, the inner (controller), (named) 'space' and the like.
speaker: Madhva
notes: Paraphrase compresses a verse that summarizes several adhikaraṇas. checked against the Devanāgarī e-text in sources_raw/raw_etexts/vedAntam/dvaitam (github.com/sanskrit/raw_etexts); numbering follows that copy and may differ in other editions
